title: Dashboard metrics query
description: The dashboard service's request: a subject, the repository filter that trims the answer to a caller's access (products and teams expand to repositories), and an allow-listed combination of measures and dimensions. One SQL statement answers it. An empty filter means the whole estate, which only a caller permitted to see everything sends.

subject.description: what the query counts; each subject carries its own dimensions and measures

repository_ids.description: the access trim: only these repositories contribute. Empty with no other filter means the whole estate

product_ids.description: expanded to repositories through the portfolio

group_by.description: the axes the answer is broken down by; at most three

where.description: dimension values the answer keeps; applied after the repository filter

order.description: the result order, measure or dimension first

limit.description: rows returned, capped by the server whatever is asked
